text: The computation π₂(S²) = ℤ in HoTT uses:
choices: the Hopf fibration and the long exact sequence
the Freudenthal suspension theorem applied to S¹ (since π₁(S¹)=ℤ and S²=ΣS¹)
explanation: π₂(S²)=ℤ: since S²=ΣS¹ and S¹ is 0-connected, Freudenthal gives π₂(ΣS¹)≅π₁(S¹)=ℤ. This is the simplest stable homotopy group computation in HoTT.
